name: @hydra/dsh-fleet-supervisor
description: Prototype: the V3 fleet supervisor — fleet timers (30 s heartbeat tick), the fleet-scheduler (durable wake queue with coalescing / budget checks / workspace resolution / skill loading / agent.followup wake), takeover on stall, orphan recovery, the silent active-run watchdog (#28), periodic fleet digests, the ready-queue rollup, and the verification-gated merge queue (#28). Registers ctx.fleetSupervisor + the fleet_wake / fleet_queue_status / fleet_digest_now / fleet_merge_enqueue / fleet_merge_status tools. Issue #26.
